text:
cheng: Quick heads-up — nightly-eval flagged ~6.3% failures in the reranker tool outputs for the quant-4bit candidate. Failures look like JSON schema validation errors (type mismatch/null vs "", example attached.
maya: ugh. can you paste one example? which field is failing?
sam: grabbing from the eval logs now, here's one raw tool output we saw:
sam: ```
{"candidate_id": "abc123", "score": 0.87, "meta": {"reason": "empty_response"}, "details": {"rank_reason": "", "duration_ms": 12}}
```
maya: The schema expects `rank_reason` to be nullable:string (i.e. null or string) but downstream validator treats empty string as invalid in our strict JSON schema. So the nightly check marks it as a schema violation.
cheng: Right — interestingly, the non-quantized baseline returns `null` for `rank_reason` in the same prompt. The 4-bit quantized model returns an empty string instead. Looks like generation/regression introduced an empty-string token emission.
eva: Is this only for reranker_v2 or across other tool schemas too? Nightly report mentioned reranker + embed post-process.
sam: I scanned a sample set: reranker_v2 ~6.3% failures, reranker_v1 ~0.4%, other tools negligible. So probably a model/regression for the new bring-up + quant profile.
nightly-bot: nightly-eval report uploaded: https://internal/reports/nightly/1815009999 (summary: 6.3% schema failures, top diff = reranker_v2 rank_reason empty-string)
maya: Possible fixes:
- adapt schema validator to accept empty-string as equivalent to null for that field (coercion layer)
- patch the prompt/template to bias generation toward explicit null token (e.g., instruct: "use null for rank_reason when no reason")
- fix post-processing: coerce empty-string -> null before validation
Which approach do we want for short-term? We need a hotfix for CI and nightly alerts.
cheng: Prefer post-process coercion in eval harness (safe minimal change). Add a rule: for reranker_v2.details.rank_reason if `""` -> set null. Also log counts so QA can watch.
eva: Agreed. Also add a regression test in nightly that asserts type normalization consistent across quant configs.
sam: I'll open a tiny PR with the coercion and a regression test. Patch will live in `evals/reranker/normalizers.py` and is just ~8 lines.
infra-bot: Deploy note: nightly-eval job runs on `eng-ml-nightly` k8s pool. If you change eval harness, canary deploy to `eng-ml-nightly-canary` before flipping global. No infra changes needed.
maya: Also, we should record whether the empty-string emission correlates with sequence-length or quant checkpoint. Sam, can you add a small histogram of lengths vs failures in the patch logs?
sam: yes. Will include length bucket counts and quant-checkpoint tag in the log metadata.
cheng: Plan: sam PR -> canary run tomorrow morning -> if passes, flip and silence current noisy alerts. Also add a follow-up ticket to upstream model team to investigate why quantized weights favor empty tokens.
eva: Add that ticket to the "model-onboarding" board and tag `severity:low-medium` and `owner:ml-infra`.
maya: One more note: downstream consumers might treat empty string differently (some clients expect blank string and don't handle null). We should communicate changes in the schema normalization in the release notes for the eval harness and in the model-rollout doc.
sam: PR link: https://git/redwood/evals/pull/452 (will add logs shortly). I'll run a local subset with `./scripts/run_eval.sh --model reranker_v2 --limit 200` and paste results here when done.
sam: Local run done: after coercion, failures dropped to 0.5% (mostly true schema mismatches now). Uploaded small CSV to PR.
cheng: cool, thanks. leaving this thread open until canary completes. tagging @maya for release notes.
maya: got it. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
nightly-bot: Note: alert suppressed for reranker_v2 schema failures until 2026-03-22 08:00 UTC per triage.
